extracted.name: Coconut Pancake Syrup
extracted.description: Try this recipe for coconut-flavored syrup next time you make waffles or pancakes.
instruction_lines: Whisk together the coconut milk and cornstarch in a saucepan until the cornstarch is dissolved. Pour in the corn syrup, sugar, and coconut; bring to a boil, stirring continually. As soon as the mixture comes to a rolling boil, remove from heat. Allow to cool completely before serving.
